question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Calendr**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Conscientious"** means wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly. (ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example: **She was a conscientious worker, always staying late to ensure the job was done right.
 
 
 
• **"Calendr"** is the misspelled word; the correct spelling is **"Calendar"**, which refers to a system of organizing days for social, religious, commercial, or administrative purposes. (कैलेंडर)
 
 
• **Example: **I marked the meeting date on my calendar to ensure I wouldn't forget it.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrect spelling among the options is 'Calendr'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Calendr**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conscientious **(ईमानदार): Characterized by taking one's duties seriously and diligently.

 
 
• **Example:** His conscientious approach to work earned him the Employee of the Month award.
 
 
 
• **Colleague **(सहकर्मी): A person with whom one works, especially in a profession or business.
 
 
• **Example: **My colleague and I collaborated on the project to ensure its success.
 
 
 
• **Conspicuous** (स्पष्ट): Easily seen or noticed; attracting special attention.
 
 
• **Example:** The conspicuous error in the report was quickly spotted by the manager.
